torch2:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

model = nn.Linear(3, 1)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()

x = torch.randn(4, 3)
y = torch.randn(4, 1)

output = model(x)
loss = criterion(output, y)
loss.backward()

with torch.no_grad():
    for param in model.parameters():
        param -= 0.1 * param.grad

print(loss.item())
expected_changes: Removed direct manipulation of param.data and param.grad.data
Performed manual parameter updates inside torch.no_grad()
Replaced loss.data[0] with loss.item()

import torch
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset

x = torch.randn(100, 10)
y = torch.randn(100, 1)
dataset = TensorDataset(x, y)

loader = DataLoader(
    dataset,
    batch_size=32,
    shuffle=True,
    num_workers=0,
    pin_memory=torch.cuda.is_available()
)

for batch_x, batch_y in loader:
    print(batch_x.size())
    break
